depthEncoding.channels: RG uint16 big-endian; B layer 1 far / 2 middle / 3 near / 4 haven; A opaque coverage. Larger decoded depth is nearer.

surfaceEncoding.albedo: RGB = sampled material color before illumination; A opaque coverage
surfaceEncoding.roughSpec: R roughness, G specular, B AO, A clamp(emission / 2), all byte-normalized

layerEncoding: Premultiplied geometry RGB plus additive air; composite layer.rgb + behind*(1-layer.a). Preserve RGB at alpha=0, decode without alpha premultiplication or color conversion.

energy.composite: base*(1-a)+rgb; RGB includes zero-alpha halo. Core source is a subset of pollution; never double-add. Existing base contains fixed sources at factor=1.

gait.progress: Walk frames 0..11 advance by actual XZ displacement / strideMetres, never by elapsed time. Frames 12..35 lower the suspended foot at each cycle pose in two stages; planted-foot XZ remains fixed.

actor.depth: Same RG encoding as scene, but camera depth relative to the actor world origin. Add dot(actorWorld-camera.target,cameraBack).
actor.shadowEncoding: Per-frame shadowCapsules contain [ax,ay,az,bx,by,bz,radius]. Endpoints are yaw-rotated world-axis offsets from actor origin; add world position without another rotation.
actor.contact: Local floor-contact alpha only; not a replacement for directional shadows. Relative-depth atlas can reconstruct the full pose caster.

stations.name: 核心
stations.description: 右沿圣龛中，不闭合的铁冠与重夹具收束异界暗质；受约束的能量团内部翻涌，灰绿光向四周辐射，成为破碎世界里的灯塔。注入薪柴修复，降低出击混乱增速。

stations.name: 储藏
stations.description: 封闭的顶压观察井，窄缝下可见被关物抵压；承压盖、螺杆与深收容腔构成完整机体。修复提高薪柴价值。

stations.name: 净化器
stations.description: 两只分离腔由管路相接；厚壁端侧检视窗与顶部观察缝露出层叠滤芯、内壁和低位污染收集槽。修复降低踏入裂隙时的起始混乱。

stations.name: 供奉
stations.description: 厚壁回收管环的偏心孔贯通前后，下沿夹件暴露并控制残渣；压力穿孔而过。装入物件供其抵御冲击并转化。

stations.name: 蜕变
stations.description: 可容人体的旧式立缸，暗色半透明介质中隐约有躯体般的物质与稀少气泡。通过培养藏刻入永久成长和模块加厚。

stations.name: 裂隙
stations.description: 左前断沿中的时空伤口；从内侧完整地坪靠近并备行。

occluders.encoding: triangles is flat XYZ vertices: nine float values per triangle. Exact authored static opaque triangles; actor geometry excluded.

exteriorFields.motion: XZ-only observation; continuous radial saturation; far <=6px, middle <=3.5px, bonded near layer 0px. Colour, depth, light and material data use the same UV.
